content: Employees are entitled to 18 paid leaves per calendar year. Leave requests up to 2 days can be self-approved and logged. Requests longer than 2 days require manager approval before being finalized.
Sick leave is capped at 6 days per year and does not require advance notice, but must be logged within 24 hours of returning to work.
Hardware issues such as slow laptops, broken screens, or peripheral failures should be reported by creating a support ticket. Severity is classified as low, medium, or high based on impact on work.
Employees can request installation of approved software via a support ticket. Unapproved or licensed third-party software requires manager sign-off before a ticket can be created.
Password resets are considered a critical security action. They require identity verification and explicit human approval before being executed, since they affect account access.
Deactivating or deleting an employee account is a critical, irreversible action. It always requires explicit human approval regardless of who requests it.
If an issue cannot be resolved through standard tickets (e.g. repeated hardware failure, policy disputes, harassment concerns), it should be escalated directly to HR for manual review.
Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week without approval. More than 2 days per week requires manager approval logged as an exception request.
Travel and equipment reimbursements under 2000 INR can be auto-approved by creating a reimbursement ticket. Amounts above that require manager approval.
Employees can check their remaining leave balance at any time by querying the HR system; this is a read-only, non-critical action.
